{
  "name": "agentex",
  "version": "0.4.0",
  "description": "AgenTeX: 14 skills + 2 hooks that keep LaTeX papers honest to the code behind them: verified citations with a cite guard, results-to-macros sync with stale-number audits, a compile-and-fix loop, TikZ, equations, tables, prior-work search, overlap screening, mock peer review and arXiv packaging.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Metahemeralism"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/Metahemeralism/AgenTeX",
  "repository": "https://github.com/Metahemeralism/AgenTeX",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "latex",
    "tikz",
    "beamer",
    "bibtex",
    "arxiv",
    "peer-review",
    "research",
    "academic-writing",
    "skills"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "animations": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Animations",
      "description": "Show the AgenTeX band above the prompt: a one-time welcome after install and a small animation while AgenTeX checks run.",
      "default": true
    }
  }
}
